meta.title: TraceCart — Get it there.
meta.description: Sourcing and cross-border logistics for landlocked and difficult-to-reach markets. Tell us what needs to move — we'll work out the route.

quoteBar.whatPlaceholder: Describe the product or tool in your own words: what it's for, the brand or model if you know them, how many… or just add a photo or a video.
quoteBar.disclaimer: We look for the product at sellers and manufacturers, then rank it by accuracy and price. A free account is needed to see the results.
quoteBar.submittedBody: Someone from the team will reply to confirm the product and ask where it needs to go.
quoteBar.attach: Add a photo or a video
quoteBar.photoHint: Photo (PNG, JPEG, WebP, 5 MB) or video (MP4, MOV, WebM, 20 MB, 30 s)
quoteBar.photoInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of 5 MB or less, or an MP4, MOV or WebM video of 20 MB or less.
quoteBar.needWhat: Describe the product or add a photo.
quoteBar.pickHint: Prices are delivered to you, customs estimated apart. Buy directly, or pick the closest one and send us the request: we check the exact model before we reply.
quoteBar.noneTitle: We couldn't find this product online.
quoteBar.noneBody: That's fine: send the request and someone will look for it for you.
quoteBar.needsDescription: We couldn't read the photo. Add a few words about the product.
quoteBar.limited: Partial search today: someone will complete it.
quoteBar.name: Name
quoteBar.failed: The request couldn't be sent. Try again in a moment.
quoteBar.dropHere: Drop the photo or video here
quoteBar.signUpNeeded: Create a free account to see the results: we keep your description and photo.
quoteBar.staffAccount: You're signed in with a staff account: use a customer account to search.
